designs: A 21 year old Black British man from Hackney, East London, deep warm voice, thick roadman London accent with a Caribbean lilt. Very expressive and animated, big rising and falling intonation, playful and cheeky, laughs a little while talking, stretches words for drama, natural slang delivery.

A young man from South London, deep bassy voice, strong Multicultural London English roadman accent, dramatic storyteller, sarcastic but energetic, lots of pitch movement, emphasises key words, sing-song Jamaican-influenced rhythm, unpolished real voice.

A 22 year old from Tottenham, North London, deep slightly raspy voice, heavy London street accent, gossiping excitedly like he is spilling the tea, exaggerated intonation going up and down, punchy and lively, real and casual.
